# VRG classification

*Generated by `node Dashboard/tools/classify.js` from `inventory.json` (what exists) and `launcher/vrg-catalog.json` (the decision).
Terms: `GLOSSARY.md`. Re-run after the inventory or the catalog changes.*

## The rule

- **User** (*Felhasználó*): what a person opens to do the actual work — design, pricing, materials, field, files, mail, web — and the shell itself.
- **Dev** (*Fejlesztő*): everything User has, plus what is secondary, background, build / test / maintenance or settings level. Each Dev item is drawn
  **behind its parent**: a User item (Planner → build, test, gyro relay, Planner CYD) or one of six **dev roots** for items with no User parent:
  `dev:repo` Repó & Git · `dev:ai` Ügynökök & AI · `dev:knowledge` Tudás · `dev:infra` Infrastruktúra · `dev:hw` Eszközök & hardver · `dev:look` Megjelenés.
- **All** (*Minden*): Dev plus third-party programs, tier 4–5 plans and ideas, stubs, spikes, internal modules and id schemes — the flat, filterable catalog.

| Level | Rows | Catalog items |
|---|---:|---:|
| user | 118 | 33 |
| dev | 284 | 52 |
| all | 124 | 6 |
| **total** | **526** | **91** |

## Naming collisions and the proposed names

| Word | What it means today | Proposal |
|---|---|---|
| **Console** | Varler Console (field companion PWA, :8133) · Board Console (a dev board's web UI, :8790) · START (a text console UI) · Open MCT "installer console" (spike) · "console" = terminal in industry use | Varler Console → **Varler Terep** (*Varler Field*, companion app); Board Console → **Board Web** (*device web UI*); START → **START tartalék indító** (*fallback launcher*); "konzol" kept only for terminals |
| **SUI** | Planner "Simplified UI" (a mode of the Planner with a corner dial) · "Varler SUI" (HUD design tokens + ring, Console/design/tokens.json) | Planner mode → **Egyszerű mód** (*Simple mode*); the corner dial component → **Sarokvezérlő** (*corner dial*, `sui-dial.js`); Varler SUI → **Varler HUD** (*HUD design system*) |
| **Dashboard / Irányítópult / Desktop** | Irányítópult = the Electron app today (`Dashboard/`) · Kezdőlap = its D0–D4 page · "VRG Desktop Dashboard" = feature f12 · VRG Desktop = the planned shell | the program → **VRG Asztal** (*VRG Desktop*, the shell, `VRG Desktop.exe`); its two primary views → **Irányítópult nézet** (*Dashboard view*, the Kezdőlap grows into it) and **Asztal nézet** (*Desktop view*); folder `Dashboard/` keeps its name for now |
| **Rétegverem** | the VRG Stack (whole system) · `stack-search.html` · START R submenu · the Dashboard pane "stack" (context packs) · VRG Mobile M17 | system → **VRG Rétegverem** (*VRG Stack*); `stack-search.html` → **Rétegkereső** (*Stack search*); the pane → **Kontextuscsomag** (*Context packs*) |
| **Napló** | START N (git log) · DevLog (fejlesztési napló) · Futásnapló (U layer) · Döntésnapló (Q layer) · the Desktop audit log | START N → **Git napló** (*Git log*); the others keep their compound names, never bare "Napló" |
| **Kapu** | the sign-in gate · the guest tool page `vrg-kapu.html` · Kapu segéd (companion server :8795) · Kapu admin (:8798) | gate → **Kapu (belépés)** (*Gate*); page → **Kapu vendégoldal** (*Guest page*); keep segéd / admin |
| **Toolbox** | `toolbox.html` (a hub page of tools, START 7) · the `Toolbox/` folder (holds the Valena picker) | retire `toolbox.html` into the catalog; folder → `Pickers/` later (a rename touches START 5 and OTG; Founder's call) |
| **Munkamenet / Munkatér / session** | Zen munkamenet (browser tab sets, START Z) · Munkaterek (saved Desktop layouts) · a Claude session | Zen sessions retire into **Munkaterek** (*Workspaces*); "munkamenet" kept for Claude sessions only |
| **Gömb** | Solomon Gömb (G layer, desktop) · VRG Mobile M14 Gömb (the same signals on the phone) | one thing on two surfaces: keep **Solomon Gömb**; EN **Solomon Sphere** everywhere (not "Data Globe") |
| **Indítópult** | VRG Mobile M11 (START from the phone) · START itself · the Irányítópult | M11 → **Távindító** (*Remote launcher*) |
